## Goal
A 1200x630 Open Graph image for the setup file reference page, designed as a pair with WO-170. Full brief, exact on-image text, alt text and shared specs (palette, type, logo source): docs/design/CANVA_BRIEFS_SEO.md sections "Shared specs" and "CBS-02". The brief wins over this summary.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Size and format exactly as the brief; file size within the brief's target.
- On-image text is the brief's text, word for word; no other words.
- Colours and type from the brief's shared specs (brand/v3/tokens-notes.md); the logo only from brand/logo/final, placed unaltered.
- Text contrast at least 4.5:1 against its background; readable as a small thumbnail.
- No real personal data, no real people's photos, no broker or bureau logos.
- One row per file in brand/codex/MANIFEST.md: file, WO, Canva design link, Canva stock elements used (or "none"), alt text from the brief.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- brand/codex/WO-171/ (new files only)
- brand/codex/MANIFEST.md (append your rows)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
brand/ outside brand/codex/, web/, src/, every other file. No GitHub commits or PRs for this WO; status goes on the WO-171 issue as a comment.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md and a comment on the WO-171 issue in FreeMyID/freemyid-pm when done. The graphic-designer reviews, then Sam files the web placement request.
